documents.body: The Harbour Authority of Eastmere said seven container vessels called on Tuesday. Northvale Freight said it had diverted two services.
documents.title: Harbour Authority of Eastmere reports seven container calls in 24 hours

documents.body: Two feeder services skipped Eastmere this week, a shipping agent told the Example Port Gazette.
documents.title: Eastmere quay cranes idle as two feeder services skip the port

documents.body: The Harbour Authority said dredging works have closed the northern berth.
documents.title: Dredging closes the northern berth at Eastmere until further notice

documents.body: The regulator said it would review berth allocation rules at Eastmere.
documents.title: Regulator signals review of Eastmere berth allocation

documents.body: Northvale Freight announced a surcharge on cargo routed through Eastmere.
documents.title: Northvale Freight lifts surcharge on Eastmere calls

documents.body: A Halden Port Study working paper put weekly throughput below its trailing average.
documents.title: Halden Port Study: throughput below trend for a sixth week

documents.body: Pilots said queues at the outer anchorage were shorter because fewer ships arrived.
documents.title: Eastmere pilots report shorter queues but fewer arrivals

text:
Container traffic through the Port of Eastmere fell over the window compared with the previous six weeks. The reporting reviewed notes that “Arrival volume drop: confirmed low calls (only seven vessels)” [R1] and that “No material change; throughput remained low as in the prior read of 2026-10-08” (indicating traffic remained at minimal levels).

Stated confidence: 0.97
